name: Dragonborn
summary: Proud, dragon-blooded people who walk on two legs. Dragonborn carry the power of their draconic ancestors: a breath weapon and resistance to the same element.

age.summary: Dragonborn grow fast, are adults by 15 and live to around 80.

alignment.summary: Dragonborn tend toward extremes, siding firmly with good or evil.

size.description: Dragonborn are taller and heavier than humans, well over 6 feet.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.summary: Pick a dragon type. It sets your breath weapon's damage type and shape, and your damage resistance.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.summary: As an action, exhale destructive energy in your ancestry's shape. Each creature in it makes a save (DC 8 + CON modifier + proficiency bonus), taking 2d6 damage on a failure and half on a success. The damage grows to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th and 5d6 at 16th. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Damage Resistance
features.summary: You resist the damage type of your draconic ancestry.
